```{r setup}
# WEEK is set by the page that includes this file (index.qmd, weeks/week-NN.qmd, or the share copy)
source("R/data.R"); source("R/ui.R"); source("R/sim.R"); source("R/brand.R"); source("R/report.R"); source("R/card.R"); source("R/standings_section.R"); source("R/sim_section.R")

lg  <- load_league()
sc  <- load_scores(lg, WEEK)
res <- sc$results
wk  <- res %>% filter(week == WEEK)
st  <- build_standings(res, WEEK)
hp  <- hist_positions(load_history())
pending <- sum(wk$pending)
lu    <- lineups(sc, lg, load_rosters(lg))
ohist <- ros_history(lu, res, lg, WEEK)
odds  <- ohist %>% filter(week == WEEK)
prevo <- ohist %>% filter(week == WEEK - 1)

SECTIONS <- c(standings = "Standings", race = "The Race", weekly = "Week by Week",
              context = "Historical Context", final = "Standings vs. Final Finish", sims = "Sim Center")
```

```{r top}
tagList(masthead(WEEK, pending), toc_bar(SECTIONS))
```

```{r standings}
tags$section(class = "rs", id = "standings",
  h2(class = "rs-head", sprintf("Standings after week %d", WEEK)),
  standings_table(st, wk),
  div(class = "note", "Ranked by F1 points, then average weekly finish, then points scored. Wk = this week's finish. W = wins, Pod = podiums (top 3), Pts = points finishes (top 6). +F1 = F1 points this week. $ = prize money won this season."),
  if (pending > 0) div(class = "note prov", sprintf("Provisional: %d player%s still to play this week.", pending, if (pending == 1) "" else "s")))
```

```{r race}
tags$section(class = "rs", id = "race",
  h2(class = "rs-head", "The Race"),
  p(class = "dek", "F1 points by week."),
  race_chart(res, st, hp, WEEK))
```

```{r weekly}
tags$section(class = "rs", id = "weekly",
  h2(class = "rs-head", "Week by Week"),
  p(class = "dek", "Each team's finish every week, in standings order."),
  finish_grid_chart(res, st, WEEK))
```

```{r context}
tags$section(class = "rs", id = "context",
  h2(class = "rs-head", "Historical Context"),
  context_rows(st, res, hp, WEEK),
  div(class = "note", sprintf("Compared with %s. 2024 is left out: it was a 10-team league.", and_list(HIST_YEARS))))
```

```{r final}
tags$section(class = "rs", id = "final",
  h2(class = "rs-head", "Standings vs. Final Finish"),
  p(class = "dek", "How closely the standings after each week matched the final standings (0 = no relation, 100 = identical)."),
  settle_chart(hp, WEEK),
  settle_rows(hp, WEEK),
  div(class = "note", sprintf("Seasons %s, official tiebreak.", and_list(HIST_YEARS))))
```

```{r sims}
tags$section(class = "rs", id = "sims",
  div(class = "rs-kick", "The GTS Sim Center", span(class = "rs-tag", HTML("Sims by <b>Golden Ticket Sims</b>"))),
  h2(class = "rs-head", sprintf("Title odds after week %d", WEEK)),
  p(class = "dek", sprintf("%s simulated finishes to the season, from this season's results only.", format(ROS_N, big.mark = ","))),
  sim_odds_table(odds, prevo, st),
  div(class = "note", "Title = most F1 points after week 18. Wk = change in title odds since last week. Proj F1 = average final F1 points, with the range covering 80% of simulated seasons."),
  h3(class = "rs-sub", "Title odds by week"),
  p(class = "dek", "Each week's odds, rerun with the results to that point. Current top 5 in colour."),
  odds_by_week_chart(ohist, odds, WEEK),
  h3(class = "rs-sub", sprintf("Week %d sims", WEEK + 1)),
  next_week_block(WEEK),
  div(class = "note", "How it works: each team's weekly scoring level is its average so far. Every simulated week draws a score for each team, ranks the 12 and awards 15/10/7/4/2/1 F1 points. A team's level can drift week to week (injuries, trades, waivers), so nothing is locked in. Checked against 2022, 2023 and 2025."),
  ad_card())
```

gts_footer()
